# dude

A software factory: a deterministic control plane that drives disposable AI
agent workers through implementation, review, fixing, simplification and
pull-request delivery.

The guiding rule, from `software-factory-plan-v0.9.md`:

> The LLM is a worker, not the workflow engine and not the source of truth.

Long waits — human questions, CI, PR reviews, capacity, timers — happen in the
control plane with no agent running and no tokens burning. Agents are woken
only when there is genuinely new information that needs judgment.

**See it work:** [`docs/demo/delivery.mp4`](docs/demo/delivery.mp4) is a
two-and-a-half-minute recording of a task going from the board to a
merged pull request on GitHub, driven entirely through the UI.

**Picking this up?** Read [`docs/CONTRIBUTING.md`](docs/CONTRIBUTING.md) for how
the system fits together, the decisions already made, and what is next.

1	-- 099_tier_effort.sql — reasoning effort belongs to the model tier, not the role.
     2	--
     3	-- A tier carries how hard its model thinks and the extra settings its agent
     4	-- is requested with, so "Thinker (High)" and "Thinker (Medium)" are two tiers
     5	-- on one model. The orchestrator turns them into OpenCode model options
     6	-- (phases.openCodeConfig): a new model setting is a tier edit.
     7	--
     8	--   effort   none | low | medium | high | max; NULL is the model's default.
     9	--   options  extra OpenCode model options, a JSON object merged over what the
    10	--            effort makes (the tier's win). At most 4 KB serialised.
    11	--   headers  extra request headers, {name: value}, names in RFC 9110 token
    12	--            syntax, values one line. At most 4 KB serialised.
    13	--
    14	-- modelTierInputSchema (packages/domain) holds the same bounds.
    15	
    16	-- Whether a JSON value is request headers: an object of token-named string
    17	-- values with no line breaks. A function because a CHECK takes no subquery.
    18	CREATE FUNCTION model_tier_headers_valid(h jsonb) RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE AS $$
    19	  SELECT jsonb_typeof(h) = 'object' AND NOT EXISTS (
    20	    SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_each(h) e
    21	    WHERE e.key !~ '^[!#$%&''*+.^_`|~0-9A-Za-z-]+$'
    22	       OR jsonb_typeof(e.value) <> 'string'
    23	       OR (e.value #>> '{}') ~ '[\r\n]')
    24	$$;
    25	
    26	ALTER TABLE model_tiers
    27	  ADD COLUMN effort text CHECK (effort IN ('none', 'low', 'medium', 'high', 'max')),
    28	  ADD COLUMN options jsonb CHECK (jsonb_typeof(options) = 'object' AND octet_length(options::text) <= 4096),
    29	  ADD COLUMN headers jsonb CHECK (model_tier_headers_valid(headers) AND octet_length(headers::text) <= 4096);
    30	
    31	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION model_tier(t model_tiers) RETURNS json LANGUAGE sql STABLE AS $$
    32	  SELECT json_build_object('id', t.id, 'name', t.name, 'description', t.description, 'model', t.model,
    33	    'effort', t.effort, 'options', t.options, 'headers', t.headers,
    34	    'position', t.position, 'updatedAt', t.updated_at,
    35	    'updatedBy', (SELECT json_build_object('id', p.id, 'name', p.name) FROM people p WHERE p.id = t.updated_by))
    36	$$;
    37	
    38	-- New organisations: Thinker thinks hard, Coder moderately, Fast at the
    39	-- model's default. Tiers there now keep NULL: nothing they run changes.
    40	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION seed_model_tiers_for(org text, thinker_model text, coder_model text) RETURNS jsonb
    41	LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public, pg_temp AS $$
    42	DECLARE
    43	  ids jsonb := jsonb_build_object(
    44	    'Thinker', 'mtr_' || substr(replace(gen_random_uuid()::text, '-', ''), 1, 24),
    45	    'Coder', 'mtr_' || substr(replace(gen_random_uuid()::text, '-', ''), 1, 24),
    46	    'Fast', 'mtr_' || substr(replace(gen_random_uuid()::text, '-', ''), 1, 24));
    47	  models jsonb;
    48	  role text;
    49	BEGIN
    50	  INSERT INTO model_tiers (id, organization_id, name, description, model, effort, position) VALUES
    51	    (ids->>'Thinker', org, 'Thinker', 'Reads, plans, judges and tidies. Slow and thorough.', thinker_model, 'high', 0),
    52	    (ids->>'Coder', org, 'Coder', 'Writes and fixes code for hours at a time.', coder_model, 'medium', 1),
    53	    (ids->>'Fast', org, 'Fast', 'Small, mechanical jobs where speed beats depth.', NULL, NULL, 2);
    54	  SELECT default_agent_models INTO models FROM organizations WHERE id = org;
    55	  FOREACH role IN ARRAY ARRAY['conductor', 'brainstorm', 'investigator', 'reviewer', 'simplifier', 'qa_browser', 'implementer'] LOOP
    56	    models := jsonb_set(models, ARRAY[role], COALESCE(models->role, '{}'::jsonb)
    57	      || jsonb_build_object('tier', ids->>(CASE role WHEN 'implementer' THEN 'Coder' ELSE 'Thinker' END)));
    58	  END LOOP;
    59	  UPDATE organizations SET default_agent_models = models WHERE id = org;
    60	  RETURN ids;
    61	END $$;
